# Sofia Serenata — Sofia Gallego, violin & voice for events

> Sofia Gallego is a singer (lyric soprano) and violinist based in Paris, performing live at weddings, receptions, cocktails, private and corporate events across Paris and Île-de-France. She has more than 20 years on stage in Chile, Switzerland, the United States and France, and sings in five languages.

## What she offers
- Solo: violin or voice for a ceremony, cocktail or background atmosphere (guide price from €200)
- Duo: voice + piano, or violin + guitar, for cocktails and receptions (from €400)
- Ensemble: string quartet, choir or a custom ensemble (from €800)
- Birthday parties: solo violin or voice for an apartment, restaurant room or garden; moves between tables, takes song requests (from €200)
- Corporate events: cocktails, dinners, product launches and end-of-year parties in Paris, Île-de-France and beyond; sets of 1 to 3 hours (solo from €200, duo from €400)
- Weddings: ceremony, cocktail and reception, timing agreed with the officiant (from €200)
- Custom arrangements for a first dance, an entrance or any special moment
- Sound: brings her own equipment for gatherings up to about 50 guests; for larger rooms she connects her violin and voice microphones to the venue's sound system

Prices are guides and depend on duration, venue and setup.

## Repertoire
Classical (Bach, Mozart, Puccini, opera and zarzuela), French chanson (Piaf), Latin American songs, and international pop (Coldplay, Taylor Swift and more). The full, searchable list with audio previews is on the homepage.

## Background
Soloist in operas, zarzuelas and musical theatre; chamber music; recordings and television appearances in Chile; performances in hotels (including the Ritz-Carlton), embassies, salons and theatres in Chile and France. Also an astrophysicist and writer — see sofiagallego.com.

- [Score Library](https://sofiaserenata.com/scores/): a working library of her arrangements for violin and voice, with scores that adapt to the screen, play along and work offline; open to musicians on request (sign-in required)
